title: Anomaly detection dataset
summary: This dataset is used to train models for detecting anomalous items based on their links to other items (both direct and transitive). This dataset has been created by querying the CLOSER repository REST API using https://github.com/CLOSER-Cohorts/colectica-api, performing feature reduction with PCA, using an isolation forest to suggest outliers, then using a human-in-the-loop to examine the outliers in order to generate a labelled dataset. Each item type has its own dedicated model.

target.name: Anomaly
target.description: A binary flag indicating if an item is anomalous (1) or not (0).

features.name: Category Set
features.description: A float containing either the value 0.0 (the item has no relationship to an item of this type), 1.0 (the item has a transitive relationship to an item of this type, e.g. x references y which references an item of this type) or 5.0 (the item directly references an item of this type).
